newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Podravka most active.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Podravka most active.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed to higher on Wednesday, with food processor Podravka accounting for over half of the trade.
* Seven of 12 active issues rose, two fell and three were flat.
* Volume down to 7,825 units, turnover halved to 3.4 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer shipper Jadranska Plovidba added five kuna or 5.3 pct to 100, on volume of 222 shares.
* Biggest decliner fully-listed Varazdinska Banka A-series lost 15 kuna or 6.4 percent to 220 on volume of 290 shares.
* Most active Podravka inched up one kuna to 263, with 4,788 shares sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
